name: Story
summary: Turns trips into Instagram-style stories: bike tours with their GPX tracks, but also treks and travels with only photos and videos. A Discord bot is the admin, so I can post from the road without a back-office.

name: Askobot
summary: A 3D character with a strong personality, used live by several Twitch streamers. It reacts to chat, commands and stream events through the Twitch API, and answers in real time with an LLM-driven personality (Mistral API).

name: Complètement à l'Est
summary: My photography portfolio, designed and built from scratch: the layout, the photo series and the maps that go with them. It was recognised by the CSS Design Awards for UI, UX and Innovation.
award: CSS Design Awards · UI, UX & Innovation
